terra.problem: The line says crowds followed Jesus in the Decapolis, but Matthew 4:25 says they came from there. The passage does not place the following or the healings in the Decapolis, so the first moment does not establish an event there.

The line says the healed man told everyone what Jesus had done. Mark 5:20 says he proclaimed it throughout the Decapolis and everyone was amazed; it does not say he told every person. “Told people throughout the Decapolis” would be more precise.
